prior_instructions.effect: Lions human franchise games only. The in-repo Huddle.gg Madden 27 defensive inventory has exactly one stock book that contains Nickel Single Mug AND the current Ravens civil formations (Nickel 2-4 Wide and Dime 2-3 Odd): Pittsburgh Steelers. Every current 12-call base play also exists in that Steelers book. This package adds the PDF p06_bot-p11_top Nickel Single Mug setups whose base plays exist in Steelers Nickel Single Mug (Cover 4 Quarters variants and Tampa 2). Cover 9 (p08_bot) and the Base Coverage 4/5 pages (p09_bot, p10_top) are not added because they have no legal stock play in that formation. CPU, Chiefs, and Titans keep the existing Ravens two-formation catalog unchanged. Macros and user assignments from the PDF are shown as setup steps and are not owner-confirmed in game (UNVERIFIED).
